svg.text: Declare the shape of nested data with Rust structs deriving View
Load a view with one batched query per relationship, never one per row
PostgreSQL, MySQL 8+ and SQLite, chosen by features and by the connection
Structs stored in columns of the containing view
Rust enums with data, stored in columns or in a table per variant, decoded strictly
Columns decoded and written as JSON with serde
References to other views by foreign key
To-many collections, ordered, placed by index, or as maps
Trees by depth-limited levels or one WITH RECURSIVE query
Arc<T> values decoded once per entity and shared
Cyclic data as a Graph of entities with typed references
Filters, ordering, paging and counting of the root rows
Filter, order and page the elements of a collection per parent, in one query
Run the queries of each level concurrently on a pool, optionally in one snapshot
Replace any query of a view with tuned SQL from a file, checked at startup
Run an override next to the generated query and log differences
A manifest of the views and the mabat command line tool: check, explain, scaffold
Load views as JSON, whole or a selection of their fields
A GraphQL schema generated from views, each root field one load
Save a value and everything it owns, creating or replacing rows by key
Save only what changed between two values of an aggregate
Version columns that make stale writes fail
Save every entity of a graph, ordered by its references, cycles included
Keys generated by the database on insert, written back into the value
Delete a value and everything it owns

27 capabilities, 81 rules in 10 areas, plus 4 conventions (DOC) and 8 things Mabat 0.1 does not do (NOT). A number is a rule of its column's area: VIEW 9 is MPA-VIEW-9. 25 rules of these areas define details no capability names on its own.
